review_scars.finding: The first owner wiring constructed one policy Snapshot from four independent SharedPreferences getter calls. A writer commit between getters can produce a transient mixed observation and a false byte/SHA integrity wound.
review_scars.action: Added HeartbeatPersistedSnapshotReader using one SharedPreferences.getAll() observation plus pure extraction regression source.

review_scars.finding: The first snapshot-reader draft silently converted present fields with unexpected stored types into canonical missing defaults, which could launder persistence type drift into WAITING or CONTACT LOST.
review_scars.action: Reader now preserves missing-key defaults but throws on present unexpected types; regression source pins that distinction.
review_scars.remaining_boundary: Future owner wiring must preserve an explicit storage-read wound without killing the poll loop, then retry until the observation changes or succeeds.
